title: boli zainab utho imdaad ko aao
body:
boli zainab utho imdaad ko aao abbas
Zib'ha hota hai mera bhai bachaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
sar to hai shaah ka ab sajdae qaaliq me jhuka
haath se shimr ke qanjar ko chudhaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ab saikina pa yateemi ka sitam toot gaya
ab taras khaao kaleje se lagaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
aag qaime me lagaane chale aae aada
ghash me hai aabide beemaar jagaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jo rida hazrate zahra ki thi mere sar par
wo rida shimr ne chini hai dilaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe be sar se hai lipti hui nanhi bachi
aao naadaan sakina ko chudhaao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saath ghurbat me ghareebo'n ka na chodho bhai
mai bulaati hu'n mere paas to aao abbas
